links.outcome: LLM final clinical rating compared with human physician reports on same cases
links.effect: o1 mean final rating 3.63 vs human physicians 3.67 (p = 0.62); Claude-3.5-Sonnet 3.38 and Llama-3.2-70B 3.23 scored significantly lower (p < 0.01 vs. o1).
links.quote: The o1 model achieved a mean final rating (3.63) statistically indistinguishable from human physicians (3.67; p = 0.62).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on retrospective clinical cases evaluated offline by expert physicians compared to human clinician reports, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
